applied.problem: [^5] sits on 'the two places should agree', but its quote only says testing from both ends gives the highest sensitivity; the citation belongs on the reason for the second test.
The notes say '18 total tests, typically core to screen and core to core'; '18 tests a cable' adds a per-cable count the notes do not give.
'One pluck sounds all of a string's notes' is too absolute: a string plucked at its centre does not sound its even harmonics, so a pluck sounds many of its notes, not all.

notes.problem: The 33 kV online-monitoring limit and the 18 tests are constants taken from the notes p.5, but carry no source and the lesson's sources hold only notes p.6; no web source confirms the 33 kV figure, so it rests on the notes alone.
